title: North Korean leader arrives in Chinese border city, Yonhap says
summary: SEOUL, South Korea – North Korean leader Kim Jong Un arrived in China’s border city of Dandong via a newly opened bridge linking the two countries, South Korea’s Yonhap news agency…

blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea – North Korean leader Kim Jong Un arrived in China’s border city of Dandong via a newly opened bridge linking the two countries, South Korea’s Yonhap news agency said on Saturday. The announcement came about a week after the major new bridge was officially opened, 12 years after its completion, deepening economic ties
